home.lead: SmartDepo is a drawn map of your storage with every item registered against the exact bin it sits in. Workers search on their phone and the bin lights up on the plan — instead of asking the one person who knows.
home.ctaNote: No card needed. Nothing is deleted when the trial ends.

demo.noMatch: Nothing by that name in this demo depot.
demo.caption: A real depot plan: zone A with three racks of six bays, a pallet row in zone B, a loading dock. Type an item — the bin lights up.

home.howTitle: Draw it once. Label it once. Then it just works.

draw.title: Draw your floor
draw.body: Drop zones, racks, pallet rows and docks onto a canvas and drag them to where they really are. A rack gets bays and levels; each cell becomes a bin with its own code, like A-01-3. Setup for a 15-person depot is an afternoon, not a project.

label.title: Print the labels
label.body: Every bin gets a printable 70×40 mm label — code in big type, path underneath, QR on the side. Print a rack’s worth at a time on ordinary label sheets and stick them on the shelf.

scan.title: Scan, count, done
scan.body: A worker points the phone camera at the label, picks the item, types the quantity. That one scan updates the map, the stock level and the movement log at the same moment — no end-of-day catch-up.

home.factsTitle: What it is — and what it isn’t

phone.title: Runs on the phone they already have
phone.body: A web app, Albanian and English, sized for a worker’s phone and a tablet by the dock. Nothing to install, nothing to update.

hardware.title: No scanners, no RFID, no hardware
hardware.body: The camera and a sheet of labels. If a label tears, the code is printed on it and can be typed.

lang.title: Any layout, your own words
lang.body: Zones, aisles, racks, platforms, pallets — nested as deep as your floor is, named the way your people already call them.

prepaid.title: Prepaid, per company, in euro
prepaid.body: One price per organization, not per user. Pay 1, 3 or 12 months up front by card, e-banking or bank transfer, with an invoice. No automatic charges.

roles.title: Admin, manager, worker
roles.body: Admins draw and invite; managers approve and report; workers scan and search. A worker can’t accidentally move a rack.

setup.title: Set up in an afternoon
setup.body: Start from a template — one zone with two racks, or four walled zones — rename what needs renaming, drag the rest into place. No importer, no consultant.

home.pricingTitle: Three plans, one price per company
home.pricingLead: Sized for a 5-person stockroom, a 15-person depot, and multi-site operations. Every plan starts with the full product for 30 days.
home.finalBody: Start the trial, draw the floor from a template, and print the first rack’s labels today. If it isn’t obviously faster than asking around, don’t pay.
home.forTitle: Anywhere things sit on shelves and someone has to find them
